## 🕹 MrProphecy Arcade (10 tools)

- [🧠 MrProphecy: Beat Memory](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-beat-memory): Simon-style pad memory that grows by one step each round, scored over real MrProphecy tracks. Audio starts with the game.
- [🏃 MrProphecy: Beat Runner](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-beat-runner): Endless runner starring MrProphecy. Jump the gaps, build speed, and the soundtrack is real MrProphecy tracks — playback only begins when you hit start.

- [🎛️ MrProphecy: Mix Board Challenge](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-mix-board): Five faders, five rounds, shrinking tolerance. Hit the target mix from the written cue. Real MrProphecy tracks run on the desk.
- [🎧 MrProphecy: Name That Track](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-name-that-track): A real MrProphecy track plays from a random point — pick the title from four options. Ten rounds, no audio until you press start.
- [🥁 MrProphecy: Rhythm Tap](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-rhythm-tap): Four-lane rhythm game scored on timing and combo, running over real MrProphecy tracks. Nothing plays until you start.
- [🛡️ MrProphecy: Studio Defender](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-studio-defender): Bad takes rain down on the studio — pop them before they land. Waves get faster. Real MrProphecy tracks play once you start.
- [🗺️ MrProphecy: Tour Manager](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-tour-manager): Twelve weeks to take MrProphecy from a Luton bedroom to a headline slot. Balance fans, cash and energy. Real tracks play while you decide.
- [💿 MrProphecy: Vinyl Catch](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-vinyl-catch): Catch falling records in the crate and dodge the cracked ones. Eight misses and the set is over. Real MrProphecy tracks play from the off.

## 🤖 AI & Autonomous Agents (10 tools)

- [🔄 AI Agent ReAct Loop Studio](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-agent-react-loop-simulator): Autonomous agent execution cycle simulator (Yao et al., Princeton). Visualizes Thought $\to$ Action $\to$ Observation state transitions and recursion limit safeguards.
- [🧠 AI Chain-of-Thought Parser](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-chain-of-thought-scratchpad): Reasoning token extractor for o1, o3, DeepSeek-R1, and Claude Extended Thinking. Separates internal scratchpad reasoning from client-facing output and detects cognitive self-corrections.
- [📊 AI Context Window Budget Lab](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-context-window-budget-calc): LLM token budget architect. Allocates context capacity across system prompt, RAG retrieval chunks, few-shots, conversation history, and reasoning tokens to prevent catastrophic truncation.
- [⚡ AI Few-Shot Prompt Builder](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-few-shot-prompt-synthesizer): In-context learning exemplar synthesizer. Enforces structured framing (XML tags vs JSON vs Markdown) and validates class distribution balance to prevent majority label bias.
- [🤖 AI Function Calling Validator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-function-call-schema-validator): Validate LLM tool-calling declarations against JSON Schema (OpenAI, Anthropic & Gemini). Tests simulated model payloads, identifies missing required fields, and detects type mismatches.
- [🔍 AI Hallucination & Fact Check](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-hallucination-entropy-gauge): Contextual grounding and hallucination risk evaluator for RAG pipelines. Pinpoints unverified entities, phantom dates, numbers, and ungrounded lexical assertions.
- [🔌 AI MCP Tool Protocol Inspector](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-mcp-protocol-tool-tester): Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 inspector and mock runner. Validates protocol compliance for Anthropic and open-agent tool calling servers.
- [💰 AI Model Cost & Speed Matrix](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-model-cost-latency-matrix): Comprehensive LLM economics & inference latency evaluator. Computes monthly token costs, prompt-caching savings, and tokens-per-second throughput across frontier and open-weight models.
- [🛡️ AI Prompt Injection Defense](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-prompt-injection-defense-lab): LLM adversarial attack analyzer. Tests agent prompts against prompt injections, delimiter hijacking, and jailbreaks, and auto-generates hardened XML containment wrappers.
- [📐 AI Vector Similarity Matrix](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-vector-embedding-similarity): RAG & vector database embedding distance engine. Computes Cosine Similarity, Euclidean $L_2$, Dot Product, and Angular separation across semantic embeddings.

- [🔴 Redshift & Cosmic Distance](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=redshift-distance-calculator): Put in a redshift and get the recession velocity, Hubble distance, light-travel time and the wavelength a known spectral line is shifted to. Distinguishes Doppler motion from cosmological expansion.
- [🔭 Telescope Collimation Check](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=telescope-collimation-check): How precisely your secondary and primary need to be aligned for the images you want, and what a star test tells you about the error you actually have. - [🌻 Backyard Bird Feeder Nutrition](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=backyard-bird-feeder-diet): Avian nutritional formulation matrix. Matches seed types to bill morphology, prevents feeder pests (squirrels/starlings), and maintains disease-free feeding stations.

- [🦅 Raptor & Flight Silhouette ID](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=bird-silhouette-flight-id): Identify raptors and aerial birds in high-overhead flight by wing aspect ratio, tail proportions, wingtip finger slots, and characteristic wingbeat cadence.
- [🎶 Bird Song Mnemonic Trainer](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=bird-song-mnemonic-trainer): Acoustic field ornithology trainer. Decode avian vocalizations using phonetic mnemonics, pitch contours, and synthesized frequency playback.
- [🔍 Avian Anatomy & Field Marks](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=bird-topography-field-marks): Standard ornithological avian topography map. Learn precise feather tracts, facial stripes, wing coverts, and bill structures to nail difficult field identifications.
- [🔭 Binocular Optics & FOV Lab](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=birding-binocular-optics-calc): Optical performance evaluator for birdwatchers. Calculates exit pupil, twilight factor, relative brightness, and converts field of view across feet, meters, and angular degrees.
- [📋 Birding Life List & Big Year](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=birding-life-list-tally): Personal field lifer ledger & annual Big Year tally. Records lifetime ticks, date of observation, habitat biome, and exports to CSV for eBird backup.
- [🌸 Hummingbird Nectar & Spoilage](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=hummingbird-nectar-spoilage): Formulate natural 20% sucrose syrup and monitor microbial fermentation rates. Calculates exact water-to-cane-sugar ratios and temperature-driven spoilage limits.
